newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo Nobel down in wake of Hoechst plunge.
newsitem.headline: Akzo Nobel down in wake of Hoechst plunge.

text.p: Shares in chemicals group Akzo Nobel NV were down 9.80 guilders, 3.4 percent, at 278.00 by early afternoon on Wednesday after a sharp fall in the shares of Hoechst in Germany, dealers said.
Shares in fellow chemicals company DSM were also down, losing 4.90 guilders to 193.40.
Hoechst shares plunged over 10 percent after it said it would not list its HMR unit and 1997 group sales would drop to between 42 and 47 billion marks from 50.9 billion in 1996.
"The Hoechst news has taken its toll on the chemicals sector," one dealer said. --Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
